questions.q: How long is the Paper 3 Speaking test and how many marks?
questions.why: Paper 3 lasts 8–10 minutes and is worth 40 marks (25%).

questions.q: Which prompts may the examiner use in Task A?
options: Warum (nicht)? / Noch etwas? / Ist das alles?
questions.why: Only these three prompts are allowed, and questions may be repeated but not rephrased.
German w = v (Wasser). German v is usually f (Vater).

questions.q: Give a two-sentence German answer to 'Was machst du in deiner Freizeit?' that includes an opinion with a reason and a future plan.
questions.model: Ich spiele gern Fußball, weil ich Mannschaftssport mag. Nächstes Jahr werde ich in einem Verein trainieren.
